title: What If Russia Fired a 10 Kiloton Nuke Over the Baltic?
description:
What would a war between Russia and NATO look like in its first 24 hours, and would one nuclear weapon end it?

A simulated day of conventional strikes on Poland and Latvia ends with one 10 kiloton warning shot over the Baltic Sea: this video follows the clock hour by hour and shows what the rings cover.

Hour zero, northern Poland: a Russian missile lands on a NATO air base. Three minutes earlier, one Iskander left a launcher in Kaliningrad. A flight that short leaves almost no warning. How does a day of conventional war end, and what line does it stop at?

This is a simulation. It has not happened. Scenario segments are labelled SIMULATION on screen; facts are labelled REAL DATA or REAL HISTORY. Every launch point, target and the order of events is ours, a scenario, not a forecast, and we set no date.
